individual_mathematical_reason: The existing independently sourced Noetherian-ring meaning has two equivalent characterizations inside one formulation. ProofWiki confirms four mathematically equivalent characterizations for commutative unital rings. Review as separate formulations under the same already screened context instead of adding another meaning. In a general noncommutative ring left/right Noetherian are distinct: do not omit commutativity if retaining the same source scope.
new_first_formulation: A commutative ring R with identity is Noetherian if every ideal of R is finitely generated.
old_first_formulation: A commutative ring R is Noetherian if every ideal of R is finitely generated; equivalently, every ascending chain I_1⊆I_2⊆⋯ of ideals eventually stabilizes.
